events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman has given us decades of incredible rock anthems. We're celebrating with a few of her best.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is 54 today! Liam Gallagher, the voice of a generation, still bringing the swagger. Expect some classic Oasis and his solo hits coming up.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic theme tunes to unforgettable gadgets, which 007 moment is your favourite? We're diving into the world of Bond.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. We're honouring his legacy with some timeless tracks.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From 'Ministry of Silly Walks' to 'Don't mention the war!', he's given us endless laughs.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's incredible voice and stage presence continue to captivate. We're celebrating the life and music of Queen's iconic frontman.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul at 61
events.blurb: On December 3rd, 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'! A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. We're taking a trip back to 1965 with some tracks from this masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever. We're honouring his incredible legacy.
